title: Form State Persistence
content: Build form persistence functionality. Auto-save: save form data periodically. Storage: localStorage or sessionStorage. Restore: restore data on page load. Clear: clear saved data on submission. Conflict: handle conflicts with server data. Expiry: expire old saved data. Indicator: show save status to user.

variants.simple: Save form state to survive page refresh and navigation.
variants.detailed: Build form persistence functionality. Auto-save: save form data periodically. Storage: localStorage or sessionStorage. Restore: restore data on page load. Clear: clear saved data on submission. Conflict: handle conflicts with server data. Expiry: expire old saved data. Indicator: show save status to user.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive form state persistence for draft saving. Save triggers: onChange with debounce (1-2 seconds), on blur, on interval (every 30s), before unload. Storage options: localStorage for persistent drafts, sessionStorage for session-only, IndexedDB for large forms. Storage key: unique per form + user + optional record ID (form_contact_user123, form_product_edit_456). Data format: {data: formValues, savedAt: timestamp, version: schemaVersion}. Restore on mount: check storage on form mount, restore if data exists and valid. Merge with defaults: restored data merged with current defaults (new fields have defaults). Conflict detection: if editing existing record, compare server version with saved draft, prompt user to choose. Clear on submit: remove saved data after successful submission. Clear on cancel: optionally clear on explicit cancel, or keep for accidental navigation. Expiry: expire drafts after 7-30 days, clean up on app load. Draft indicator: show "Draft saved" with timestamp, or "Saving..." during save. Resume prompt: "You have a saved draft from [date]. Resume or discard?" Discard option: button to explicitly discard draft and start fresh. Versioning: schema version in saved data, handle migration if form fields changed. Multiple drafts: optionally support multiple drafts per form type. Sync: for logged-in users, optionally sync drafts to server. Privacy: don not persist sensitive fields (passwords, payment info). Size limits: monitor localStorage usage, handle quota exceeded. Testing: easy clearing of persisted data in dev tools.
